notes.title: Update 3.38
notes.notes: [p]New things added this update:[/p][p][/p][p]-New OST for perks page and boxing gym ambiance for training. [/p][p]-Sanctioned fights now allow a rank difference up to 4. [/p][p]-New fighters added – Pillow Fist Haney, Paulie Negitiviti, Ivan Drogo [/p][p]-More boxer face and body skins, [/p][p]-New main title screen for wide screens. [/p][p]-General UI enhancements.[/p]

notes.title: Update 3.37 Ring Blood
notes.notes: [p]A small update that adds blood that spreads around the ring over the course of a fight.[/p][p]I've been busy lately and unable to work on the game! But should have more time soon![/p][p][/p][p]Now go smash someone's face in[/p]

notes.title: Update 3.31

notes.title: Update 3.30
notes.notes: [p]-Bugfix: Exiting a hot-seat sparring match before the first bell saved the fight as "in progress" in the campaign[/p][p]-Bugfix: "Liver Shot" was not correctly getting modified by some perks[/p][p]-Bugfix: "Liver Shot" was missing "Body Snatcher" energy drain tooltip[/p][p]-Bugfix: Fight log printed wrong fighter's name when a punch into guard broke the guard[/p][p]-Bugfix: Fight log printed wrong fighter's name when "Impenetrable Guard" triggered[/p][p]-Bugfix: "Rope a Dope" worked against "Liver Shot"[/p][p]-Bugfix: Show base hit chance for "Professional Skills"[/p][p]-Bugfix: Legendary boxers had all perks available after resetting perks[/p][p]-Prevent "Legendary" perk from getting wiped on perk reset[/p][p]-Reword Lightweight perk description for clarity[/p][p]-Critical knockdown injuries are now relevant to the punch thrown (these happen when a punch damages an opponent such that they would have less than -15 health)[/p][p]-Add new boxer skins[/p][p]-Add option to resurrect or leave legendary boxers dead when re-generating roster[/p][p]-Add new perks: "Pain Rage", "Pain Clarity"[/p]

notes.title: Update 3.29
notes.notes: [p]Small update to address cheesing the ai and perk balance.[/p][p][/p][p]- AI: Improve bot decision making in fights (specifically when cornered by a fighter with guard up and countering)[/p][p]- Manny Pacmeow gains "southpaw" perk[/p][p]- Legendary boxer's "legendary" perk no longer counts towards their perk total[/p][p]- "Fast Fist" now ignores "Peek a Boo"[/p][p]- "Glory in Death" reduces injury debuff by 30% when badly injured[/p][p]- Add audio cues when rolling boxers (the higher pitched tone the better the fighter)[/p]
